description: This file defines React components for a dialog UI element, including a Dialog component with positioning, modal behavior, and event handling, as well as a DialogToolbarButton component that toggles the dialog. It also includes utility functions for positioning.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a customizable dialog box with positioning, modal, and event handling features.

classes.name: DialogToolbarButton
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a toolbar button which toggles the visibility of the Dialog component.

methods.name: buildTopLeftCoord
methods.description: Calculates the optimal top-left coordinate for positioning the dialog within viewport bounds.

methods.name: buildTopLeftCoordWithAlignment
methods.description: Calculates the coordinate based on alignment ('left' or 'right') and checks if it fits within viewport bounds.
